cohort: 123 pregnant mothers who visited the antenatal outpatient department of Tribhuvan University Teaching Hospital.
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic negatively impacted pregnant mothers' physical wellbeing (exercise, sleep), psychological wellbeing, and led to increased fear regarding newborn outcomes.
mod_finding: Pregnant mothers expressed uncertainty on the mode of delivery due to the panic situation during the COVID-19 pandemic.
cross-section timing: During the COVID-19 pandemic, while participants were pregnant
